title: Drafthouse — Free Bootstrap 6 Architecture & Interior Design Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 architecture template — drawing-sheet design language, projects carrying area, location and RIBA status as data, practice principles, awards and an enquiry sheet.
yoastTitle: Drafthouse — Free Bootstrap 6 Architecture & Interior Design Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 architecture, architect and interior design website template with a drawing-sheet title block, project metadata, RIBA stage services, awards, team and an enquiry form using Combobox and Datepicker.
intro: Drafthouse is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 website template for architecture practices, interior designers, structural consultants and design-and-build studios. It pairs a full practice homepage — projects, principles, RIBA-staged services, awards, people and enquiries — with a project page carrying a complete data sheet.
note: The whole template is set like a drawing sheet: warm paper ground, hairline rules, nothing rounded, nothing shadowed, and metadata in small-caps labels above tabular values. That last detail is the point — every project carries area, location and RIBA stage as data rather than prose, because those are the first three things anyone commissioning a building looks for, and most practice websites bury them in a paragraph. The enquiry form uses a searchable Combobox for project type and a Datepicker for the hoped-for start.
summary: Drafthouse is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 template for architects and interior designers. The homepage opens with a full-bleed project plate carrying a drawing-style title block — area, completion, sector, status — then a project grid where each entry repeats that metadata, four numbered practice principles, services mapped to RIBA stages 0 through 6, an awards list, team profiles and an enquiry sheet built on Combobox and Datepicker. The project page adds the brief, approach, current status and a sticky project data sheet. Drawing-sheet design language throughout: warm paper, hairline rules, no rounded corners. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — practice homepage and a project page
Drawing-sheet design language: hairline rules, no rounded corners, no shadows
Title block on the hero — area, completion, sector and status as labelled data
Every project repeats that metadata rather than burying it in prose
Services mapped to RIBA stages 0—1, 2—3, 4 and 5—6
Four numbered practice principles and an awards list
Enquiry form with searchable Combobox project type and Datepicker start date
Sticky project data sheet on the project page
Project page chrome generated from the homepage so nav and footer cannot drift
Bootstrap 6 vendored at a pinned commit, ESM-only, no build step
